Four Reports Will Test The AI Buildout
These four reports will show whether the AI buildout continued through the third quarter
Lam’s orders show whether chipmakers are still expanding. Meta’s spending plans show hyperscaler demand.
And last but not least, Western Digital shows whether storage is as tight as advertised.
Analysts expect Lam to earn $2.18 per share on revenue of $8.13 billion, Meta $6.59 on $63.31 billion, IBM $2.86 on $16.82 billion and Western Digital $4.08 on $4.14 billion.
None of them is priced for a move above 10%.
